briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google race to deploy agentic systems as compute constraints tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with frontier labs releasing agentic models amid regulatory scrutiny. Funding remains robust while safety gaps persist in production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with advanced tool use; Google DeepMind releases Gemini 3.0; Meta open-sources Llama 4 for research; xAI and DeepSeek push inference optimizations.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive CAN bus, IoT, and BCI applications via patent-pending AI-negotiated security.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k GPU clusters; TSMC reports sustained AI chip demand through 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier labs before regulatory caps take effect?
